Title: NETMESSAGE:We've been holed up in this area for too long. The only way we're gonna survive is by breaking out of this place. Let's move.
Translation: 我们在这个区域躲藏太久了。唯一的生存之道就是突围出去。出发吧。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Destroy the radios to unblock the elevators circuits.
Translation: 摧毁无线电设备以解锁电梯电路。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Eliminate the human threat to save our Xen allies.
Translation: 消灭人类威胁以拯救我们的Xen盟友。

Title: NETMESSAGE:We've received a distress call from some nearby Xen allies...
Translation: 我们收到了来自附近一些Xen盟友的求救信号...

Title: NETMESSAGE:Our work here is done, let's get back down to the sewer...
Translation: 这里的工作完成了，我们回到下水道去吧...
